sources: Owner-approved twin-valley story and art plan, 17 November 2026
name: Priest Kang
role: keeper of the courtyard's civic memory

lines.text: I belong to the house of the remembered Priest-King. His face comes down to me; what we do with the courtyard is still ours to decide.
A likeness could stand here, if it leaves room for the jars and the people. Ask Nemi about the roots before you ask anyone about a pedestal.
The channels are clear because Seli clears them. A city cannot live on the memory of its rulers alone.
Your beedu will not stand on a plinth. We can remember a passing life without trying to keep it here.
There I am in stone. Remember the carver, Nemi, Eru and Renu beside the name; without their work it would only be a weight.

notes: Fictional kinship. Face should closely match the Indus Priest-King sculpture reference; archaeological title and office are not asserted as fact.
